behavioral.evidence: onClick dispatches to refreshInstalled/refreshMarketplace/refreshDiscovered; each calls invoke('invoke_mcp_tool', ...) with real MCP tool names

behavioral.label: Skill Info button (installed tab)
behavioral.evidence: showInfo calls vox_skill_info then pushToast({ body: JSON.stringify(result) }). Backend IS called but the only visible output is a raw JSON toast — no detail panel, modal, or structured display. Functionally a noop from the user's perspective.

behavioral.label: Plugin Info button (installed tab)
behavioral.evidence: showInfo calls vox_plugin_info then pushToast({ body: JSON.stringify(result) }). Same raw-JSON-to-toast pattern.

behavioral.label: Plugin Info button (marketplace tab)
behavioral.evidence: Same showInfo/raw-JSON-to-toast pattern as installed tab.

behavioral.label: Search button / Enter key in search input
behavioral.evidence: runSearch calls callTool('vox_skill_search', {query}) → invoke('invoke_mcp_tool', ...); results populate searchHits state

behavioral.label: Installed skills rows (search results)
behavioral.evidence: Only installed skills section at line 346 has `actions=[]` — click is dead for installed skills. Catalog plugin rows (line 364+) and skill-use rows (line 398) have real onClick actions wired.

behavioral.label: View button (discovered tab)
behavioral.evidence: onSkillUse calls showInfo('vox_skill_use', {id}) → pushToast({body: JSON.stringify(result)}). Same raw-JSON-to-toast pattern; no structured view.

visual.issue: Hardcoded Tailwind color classes: 'border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-400/10 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-400/20' used for 'ok' tone action buttons. Should use ds-token semantic color variables.
Hardcoded Tailwind color classes: 'border-rose-400/30 bg-rose-400/10 text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-400/20' used for 'danger' tone action buttons. Should use ds-token semantic color variables.

Skill search results render with no action buttons (actions=[]). The primary expected action (install or view) is absent, leaving a dead end after a search. Users cannot act on discovered search results.
Info buttons (skill/plugin) surface raw JSON via toast rather than a structured detail panel. Unusable as a real information surface; obscures the primary content hierarchy.

TabButton renders as <button role='tab'> but is not inside a <div role='tablist'> at the same level — the tablist is on the parent container at line 185. The TabButton component itself does not receive the tablist context, which may confuse AT traversal.

Plugin install_dir shown as subtitle; it uses break-words but the id line below (line 454) uses break-all which can produce visually fragmented mono text on narrow columns. Not clipping but readability degrades on long paths.
